units: <cite ref="Eruvin 54a:14">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>און לו ה׳ וכ׳</he> there is no end to it for all eternity. Y. Ber. XI, 10ᵃ bot. <he>ה׳ ברכה</he> an unlawful interruption between the blessing and the partaking of food. Ib. II, 5ᵇ top <he>ימי ה׳</he> intervening days during which menstruation ceased. Ib. IX, 13ᶜ bot.; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 118:21">Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 32</cite> <he>ה׳ מלכות</he> interregnum, anarchy.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 2:4:10">Y. Yeb. II, 3ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>שניות אין להן ה׳</he> the secondary degrees of forbidden marriages have no limitation; a. fr.
